purpose: Engineering capacity validation only: one frozen trained candidate, one central CUDA model, no optimizer or additional training
prerequisite: native-paired-dev-clean-01 completes all 16 strict valid games and independent raw audit is reported; any invalid dev game halts this ladder pending diagnosis
native_and_core_policy: Parent holds the current native/source snapshot fixed; every collection captures execution-time hashes, and no frozen collector/trainer/PPO is edited
gates_per_stage: Whole batch complete, all native games have exact request consumption and strict execution gates, no unconfirmed action/rejection imputation
Candidate tensors and every frozen input unchanged, actual optimizer steps zero
Sample proves N live native PIDs with N worker session leaders, rather than only queue length
Resource gates hold: available RAM >= max(2GiB,20% total), swap growth <=256MiB, native-log disk >=5GiB, batch RSS <=70% total RAM
Before next scale, peak RSS per slot x next scale x1.25 must fit measured available RAM after reserve
No token-bearing processes remain; manager exits and learner/pool leases are released before next scale

balance.8: Two training maps x two opponents x two roles, one job per cell
balance.12: CLI engineering workload is unbalanced: train01 has eight jobs, train02 four; do not present as balanced strength evaluation
balance.24: Three CLI groups of eight; verify three unique-seed jobs per two-map/opponent/role cell

limitations: These samples establish bounded CPU-simulator/CUDA-broker capacity, not independent ability improvement, a final test, or parallel optimizer updates
